Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Tanay - 10 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Pallavi - 42 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Nitin - 46 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater
4. Vihaan - 9 years, friend
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The fishermen's village - boats, nets, coconut palms
4. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Tanay stands in the courtyard. Pallavi and Nitin stand near him.]

Nitin: "Let's do something fun today."

[Tanay hugs Mother tightly.]

Nitin (happily): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Tanay nods.]

Pallavi: "And then?"

[A flock of birds flies across the sky.]

Tanay (happily): "One more time!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Tanay stands in the living room. Pallavi and Nitin stand near him.]

Nitin: "So, here we are!"

[Tanay mops the floor.]

Tanay: "Hey, look at that!"

[Tanay writes in his notebook.]

Tanay (surprised): "Yes, all right."

[Tanay types on his laptop.]

Tanay (gently): "Mom, are you okay?"

[Tanay knocks on the door.]

Tanay (gently): "This is amazing!"

Scene 3: The fishermen's village - Day

[Tanay stands in the village. Pallavi and Nitin stand near him.]

Nitin: "Tanay, look over here."

[Waves crash against the shore.]

Pallavi (happily): "Tanay, look at this."

Scene 4: The main road - Day

[Tanay stands on the road. Pallavi and Nitin stand near him.]

Nitin: "So, here we are!"

[Father drives the car; Mother sits beside him in the front and Tanay sits in the back seat.]

Nitin (gently): "That's easy."

[Tanay sits in the front passenger seat while Mother drives.]

Tanay: "Slowly, take it easy."

[The family gets into the car: Father at the wheel, Tanay in the back.]

Pallavi: "That was such a fun day!"
